purpose: Define consequential portfolio numbers, their methods, and what readers must not infer.

items.definition: A conservative lower-bound description of Jamie's work creating operating structure across civic, cultural, small-business, and technical environments.
items.unit: years of relevant project and professional practice
items.timeWindow: Career history represented in the approved resume through 2026
items.method: Derived from approved resume chronology and intentionally rounded down to a durable lower bound.
items.uncertainty: The category spans different roles and settings; it is not one continuous job title or employer tenure.
items.nextStep: Recalculate only when resume chronology materially changes.
doNotInfer: Fourteen years in one formal Technical Project Manager role.
Government employment or a professional certification.

items.definition: A description of Harry J. Epstein Co.'s organizational age during Jamie's modernization work.
items.timeWindow: Company history through the portfolio publication period
items.method: Uses approved resume language and public company context; rounded to a stable lower bound.
items.uncertainty: The number describes the business, not Jamie's tenure or the age of any specific software system.
items.projectionStatus: Published as context for legacy modernization.
items.nextStep: Retain the lower-bound form unless a public company-history citation warrants a more exact statement.
doNotInfer: Jamie worked at the company for 80 years.
All legacy processes or products were 80 years old.

items.definition: Aggregate comparison between revenue at the beginning and end of a business period during which Jamie contributed web, e-commerce, analytics, marketing, content, and workflow improvements.
items.timeWindow: The approved-resume comparison period; exact dates and financial values remain protected.
items.method: Approved resume language supported by firsthand operational context; public presentation preserves only the aggregate ratio.
items.uncertainty: Many business, market, team, and operational factors contributed; public evidence does not isolate Jamie's causal share.
items.nextStep: Seek a bounded collaborator confirmation of the period and contribution framing without exposing private financial data.
doNotInfer: Jamie caused or single-handedly produced the increase.
The underlying revenue values, margin, or profit.

items.definition: A lower-bound count of shared pages used for Commercial Rent Stabilization campaign memory and coordination.
items.timeWindow: The collaboration period represented in the approved resume and public-safe archive summary
items.method: Approved resume count supported by public-safe collaboration context; raw private coalition records remain excluded.
items.uncertainty: Page boundaries and versions may vary across tools; the claim is a conservative threshold, not a content-completeness measure.
items.projectionStatus: Published with collective-work and privacy guardrails.
items.nextStep: Create a private itemized count and retain only an aggregate method note in the public repository.
doNotInfer: Sole authorship or ownership of coalition strategy.

items.definition: Approximate count of city-level organizer ecosystems with meaningful platform activity in the surviving WOWList production data.
items.timeWindow: Surviving production records through the historical platform period
items.method: Database analysis applies a documented minimum-activity threshold to city-linked records and rounds the result for public presentation.
items.uncertainty: Location normalization, incomplete records, and different definitions of adoption can change the count.
items.projectionStatus: Published as roughly 35, never as an exact chapter count.
items.nextStep: Preserve the query and threshold beside future data-audit outputs when the backup is reprocessed.
doNotInfer: Equal activity, governance, or adoption in every city.

items.definition: A conservative aggregate of recurring Sunday Dinner gatherings across the project's operating history.
items.timeWindow: Project history represented in the approved resume through 2026
items.method: Approved resume aggregate supported by Jamie's project history; a privacy-preserving reconciliation method remains to be documented.
items.uncertainty: Public sources corroborate recurring hosting but do not independently establish the full aggregate.
items.projectionStatus: Published as a lower-bound aggregate without attendance data.
items.nextStep: Reconcile dates privately from non-sensitive scheduling records and publish only count rules and exclusions.
doNotInfer: A public attendance database or complete event archive.

items.definition: A conservative count of artists supported through resident-artist participation connected with 196 and Sunday Dinner.
items.timeWindow: Project history represented in the approved resume through 2026
items.method: Approved resume aggregate supported by public-safe project history; individual names remain unpublished unless separately approved.
items.supportStatus: careful pending method note and bounded corroboration
items.uncertainty: Residency definitions and overlapping participation require reconciliation; public sources do not independently establish the aggregate.
items.projectionStatus: Published only as 20+ with community privacy boundaries.
items.nextStep: Document inclusion criteria privately and seek role-level corroboration without publishing participant records.
doNotInfer: Ownership of artists' work or comprehensive documentation of their participation.
Twenty simultaneous residents or twenty public testimonials.

items.definition: The amount the Kansas City Council accepted and appropriated following the CCED recommendation for the KC Town Hall project.
items.timeWindow: Council action documented in the official project record
items.method: Read from official municipal legislation and appropriation records, with later withdrawal and reappropriation records retained as part of the same evidence chain.
items.supportStatus: exact official-record amount with outcome boundary
items.uncertainty: Appropriation is not evidence that an agreement was executed, funds were received, funds were spent, or the full project was completed.
items.projectionStatus: Published only with the later withdrawal and unused-funds boundary.
items.nextStep: Keep the official ordinance and later disposition records linked whenever the amount is used.
doNotInfer: KC Town Hall received or spent $490,539.
The full adaptive reuse was completed.

items.displayValue: 71 issue-recognition posts, 61 issue pages, 26 Council-member accounts
items.definition: Counts within a 110-slot archival census of the @CallNYCapp account: issue-recognition posts linked distinct resident-facing issue pages to Council-member accounts.
items.unit: posts, distinct issue-page URLs, and distinct Council-member accounts
items.timeWindow: The archived @CallNYCapp profile population recovered in 2026
items.method: A full profile-count census recovered 107 of 110 objects and classified the recovered population; three profile-counted objects remain unrecovered.
items.uncertainty: The figures describe CallNYC's outgoing public-information practice, not necessarily replies, endorsements, or actions by every mentioned account.
items.projectionStatus: Published with the census denominator and three-object recovery boundary.
items.nextStep: Preserve source identifiers and rerun only if the three missing objects are recovered or the classification method changes.
doNotInfer: Every mention produced constituent-service action or reciprocal engagement.
